name: Dashy
description: A start page configured from one YAML file: sections of links with icons, status checks and themes, editable from the page itself or in the file it keeps on its volume.

access.note: Dashy has no login until you give it one: the first visit opens the default page, and the configuration editor on it is open to anyone who reaches the address. Add users under Settings → Authentication (the page writes them into conf.yml on the volume) or keep the domain behind the dashboard's password protection.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The page and the configuration API

volumes.name: user-data
volumes.purpose: conf.yml and the icons and backgrounds uploaded to the page

update.notes: The configuration is one YAML file the new version reads as it is; a fresh volume gets the image's default conf.yml, an existing one is kept.
